
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

GPIO 36 has a hardware errata: interrupts may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep. Use a different pin for interrupt-driven input.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin motor: PWM = 4
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin battery: Analog = 36
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: GPIO 34, 35 do not have this errata.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE NOTE -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

GPIO 36: Hardware errata: interrupts on GPIO 36 may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep.

 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin battery: Analog = 36
